scripts.actions: git add . && git commit --amend --no-edit && git push origin --force-with-lease
scripts.test:integration:local: dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma db push --accept-data-loss && dotenv -e .env.test -- vitest run --dir src/modules --config ./vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:integration:ci: prisma db push --accept-data-loss && vitest run --dir src/modules --config ./vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.build: npm install typescript tsx @types/node --save-dev & npx tsc --init & npm install prisma@7.10.0 @types/pg --save-dev & npm install @prisma/client@7.10.0 @prisma/adapter-pg pg dotenv
